GAB.note: One agency's platform, not a finance, tax or payroll system.

facts.fact: The Gabonese food safety agency AGASA will launch the Nexus platform on 2 November 2026 for online applications for approvals, import authorisations and sanitary and phytosanitary certificates, and has asked operators to register at its offices from 20 to 29 October 2026.

GAB.note: Does not say who built or runs Nexus.
